change: Consume the already-owned specialized item vector when redistributing project syntax. The Borrowed branch moves combined.items; the Owned branch moves its module.items.
invariants: No into_owned is used on the Borrowed Cow: the original combined.items vector is moved directly, eliminating the final per-item clone. Earlier source normalization and specialization clones are intentionally unchanged.
The specialized items retain their original iteration order. budget.item executes before file lookup, function registration and insertion for every item, with the same spans and fallible calls.
Definition-source lookup, functions.entry(...).or_insert first-wins registration, original import cloning and the full Restore visitor are unchanged.

Only untrusted syntax ownership changes. Input syntax is borrowed and remains byte-for-byte Debug-equal after every probe call; no schema, source acceptance, logical limit, ABI, Verify or runtime representation change.
